summary: First-iteration full-stack testing for JHAX.ai landing page. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass (health, leads CRUD, validation 422s, status regression). Frontend: All requested UI flows work — hero headline, nav CTA smooth-scroll to book-demo, live demo typewriter cycles, 6 product tabs clickable, FAQ accordion (item 0 open by default, toggle works both ways), 9 feature cards, 5 loop stages (DETECT/DIAGNOSE/ACT/DEPLOY/MEASURE), marquee present, lead form submits valid email → success message + green border, no console errors on load.

integration_issues.issue: Input has type='email' which triggers browser native HTML5 validation tooltip BEFORE the onSubmit handler runs. As a result, the custom red 'lead-error' element with 'Please enter a valid email' message is NEVER rendered for invalid emails. Backend is not hit (correct), but the expected red error state defined in code is unreachable via UI. Fix: change input to type='text' (or add noValidate on form) so custom validate() function can display the styled error.

action_items: Optional: In FinalCTA.jsx, change input type='email' to type='text' OR add noValidate to <form> so the custom lead-error UI state can render for invalid emails (currently masked by native browser tooltip).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/leads uses status 200 (FastAPI default). Consider 201 for resource creation — spec says 200 so this is acceptable.
FinalCTA.jsx: input type='email' + custom validate() are redundant and native validation shadows custom error UI (see integration_issues).
TheLoop.jsx has `hidden md:hidden` on separator arrow — dead code, always hidden (harmless).
server.py stores datetime as ISO string but declares Lead.created_at: datetime — response conversion is handled, OK.
seed_data_creation: Test leads created with random uuid-prefixed emails (not cleaned up; low volume, non-blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Frontend loop-stage testids are UPPERCASE (loop-stage-DETECT etc). Only known issue is native email validation masking custom lead-error UI in FinalCTA.
